hardening.tree: the delivered runtime with the pre-hardening advisory module (the api stage itself)
hardening.scope: The unchanged M109 probes on the pre-hardening runtime: the module reads practice through M108 own reader (creating its lazy timer row), counts a row it cannot read back as a recorded session, and reports an unparseable retained-stop payload as no stops. The hardening stage made all three honest and both probes are green on the delivered tree.
